new_paragraph: Network decompositions separate positive and negative contributions while preserving their difference. The DC decomposition yields convex, monotone split-streams for the attribution methods in Chapter~\ref{ch:saliency}. The stopping decomposition applies the original ReLU gates to both streams, setting both to zero at inactive neurons and retaining the active paths used by the backward games in Chapter~\ref{ch:game_theory}. We compare their retained information and backward calculations, then stabilize them for deep networks.
